deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: A human-readable description of the rule.

enable.description:
Indicates whether or not this packet mirroring takes effect. If set to FALSE, this packet mirroring
policy will not be enforced on the network. The default is TRUE. Possible values: ["TRUE", "FALSE"]

name.description: The name of the packet mirroring rule

priority.description:
Since only one rule can be active at a time, priority is
used to break ties in the case of two rules that apply to
the same instances.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

region.description:
The Region in which the created address should reside.
If it is not provided, the provider region is used.
region.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

collector_ilb.description:
The Forwarding Rule resource (of type load_balancing_scheme=INTERNAL)
that will be used as collector for mirrored traffic. The
specified forwarding rule must have is_mirroring_collector
set to true.

collector_ilb.url.description: The URL of the forwarding rule.

filter.description: A filter for mirrored traffic.  If unset, all traffic is mirrored.

filter.cidr_ranges.description:
IP CIDR ranges that apply as a filter on the source (ingress) or
destination (egress) IP in the IP header. Only IPv4 is supported.

filter.direction.description: Direction of traffic to mirror. Default value: "BOTH" Possible values: ["INGRESS", "EGRESS", "BOTH"]

filter.ip_protocols.description: Possible IP protocols including tcp, udp, icmp and esp

mirrored_resources.description: A means of specifying which resources to mirror.

mirrored_resources.tags.description: All instances with these tags will be mirrored.

mirrored_resources.instances.description: All the listed instances will be mirrored.  Specify at most 50.

mirrored_resources.instances.url.description: The URL of the instances where this rule should be active.

mirrored_resources.subnetworks.description: All instances in one of these subnetworks will be mirrored.

mirrored_resources.subnetworks.url.description: The URL of the subnetwork where this rule should be active.

network.description:
Specifies the mirrored VPC network. Only packets in this network
will be mirrored. All mirrored VMs should have a NIC in the given
network. All mirrored subnetworks should belong to the given network.

network.url.description: The full self_link URL of the network where this rule is active.
